correctness.rationale: Direct edge-transfer gives c_prime=c+H, d_i_prime=d_i-sign(d_i)-H. The established monotone two-time diffusion potential makes every periodic edge sign alternate or stay zero, forcing F^2=id on periodic states. For F^2=id each leaf transfer cancels. A zero gap implies H=0 and all other gaps zero; mixed-sign gaps require incompatible inequalities H>=positive d and H<=negative d, so all nonfixed gaps have one sign. Center-lower gaps must satisfy 1<=d_i<=r, yielding unique phase representatives. Since S=(r+1)c+sum d_i, exact residue enumeration is obtained in Z[z]/(z^(r+1)-1) from (H(z)-1)^r=(-1)^r+((r^r-(-1)^r)/(r+1))H(z). Nonnegative c>=0 gives geometric series. Independently enumerated bounded gap boxes through r=5 and exact residue classes. Proof handles r=1 and negative unrestricted states; finite checks are corroborative.
residual_risks: Independent finite verification corroborates but cannot establish the all-parameter proof.
